title: Suggested learning sequence
intro: A sequence for an experienced senior executive in Ireland who wants to build credibility across AI transformation, strategy and advisory work, board-level governance, and practical implementation. It starts with low-cost literacy and a recognised governance credential, then moves to strategy, then hands-on building. Core steps cover all four objectives. Optional steps add depth or an alternative. Re-check dates and prices on the official page before enrolling.

stages.name: Shared vocabulary and executive framing
stages.goal: Build fluent, current understanding of generative AI and agents that you can use with boards and clients. About two to four weeks part-time.

steps.why: Free and short. Gives a practical framework for working with AI and for teaching teams to do so.
Low-cost, proctored, business-level certification. An external signal of generative AI literacy for leadership roles.
A highly rated non-technical primer. Skip it if the first two steps feel comfortable.

stages.name: Governance, regulation and assurance
stages.goal: Gain a recognised AI governance credential that covers the EU AI Act and risk management. This is the strongest differentiator for board and advisory work in Ireland and the EU.

steps.why: A highly rated, inexpensive overview of AI governance. It prepares you for the AIGP body of knowledge.
Proctored professional certification from the IAPP, the main privacy and AI governance professional body. Directly relevant to board, risk and assurance roles.

extra_costs.description: AIGP exam fee, non-member (sold separately from training; IAPP candidate handbook)

steps.why: Adds management-system skills (ISO/IEC 42001) if you expect to lead AI assurance programmes or audits.
An alternative or complement to AIGP: a university-led programme on regulation and compliance with a strong institutional brand.

stages.name: Strategy, operating model and transformation
stages.goal: Structure AI strategy, business cases and operating-model change in a way you can apply to your own organisation or clients.

steps.why: Online executive programme with a verified fee and published weekly effort. Builds strategy and business-case framing.
Dublin-based alternative. You build a strategy, roadmap and business case for your own organisation and join an Irish peer network. Check prerequisites; IMI suggests AI Build first.
Low-cost practical view of generative AI in the sales cycle. Useful for commercial and partnership conversations.

stages.name: Hands-on implementation
stages.goal: Learn enough engineering to prototype, judge vendor claims and lead delivery teams credibly: Python, LLM application building, agents, RAG and evaluation.

steps.why: Take this first if you do not already write Python. Most later steps assume it.
Explains how LLMs are trained, fine-tuned and deployed. A highly rated technical foundation.
Free, hands-on course in building applications with an LLM API, covering prompt engineering, prompt evaluation and tool use.
Free, project-based agents course with a certificate based on assessed work.
Free, project-based RAG and evaluation course. Join a live cohort if you want the certificate.
Highly rated, in-depth course on evaluating LLM products. Valuable if you will own AI product quality, but it is expensive.
Low-cost, proctored cloud credential if your clients or employer use AWS.

notes: Order is a suggestion. Stages 2 and 4 can run in parallel if you prefer variety.

If you want an assessed university qualification instead of short courses, compare ucd-smurfit-diploma-ai-business-analytics (in person, NFQ Level 9) and atu-pgdip-big-data-analytics-ai (Springboard+ funded where eligible) in the catalogue.
Free audit options rarely include graded work or a certificate. Budget for a subscription if you want the credential.
No credential here guarantees employment or advancement. Pick steps that produce evidence you can show, such as a governance framework, business case or working prototype.
